The root cause is the keyset tie-break bug. Entries created at the same moment are skipped during pagination. The ORDER BY clauses for activity, issues, and notifications all use descending id as a tie-breaker.

content.text: The keyset cursor now continues with `(timestamp, id)`, so rows recorded at the same moment stay in the page sequence.
